summary_requirements: Primary: reproducible code completions via model/version pinning and deterministic seeds. Secondary: low-latency streaming for in-IDE edits, canary rollouts with automatic eval gates (compile+lint pass, unit-run success, hallucination delta). Production must live in VPC or on-prem with KMS and audit logs. Autoscale predictable throughput for heavy CI usage.
technical_targets: p50 latency <=60ms, p99 <=180ms for single-line completions; compile-and-run pass >=95% baseline; canary rollback if compile pass drops by >0.5% or hallucination metric increases by >0.2%.
rollout_plan: Phase 1: hosted API POC (2 weeks) to validate latency/quality. Phase 2: Dedicated pool POC behind VPC, 5% traffic canary with automatic eval gates. Phase 3: Private deployment for prod with model-version-lockfile and CI integration for reproducibility.
eval_gates_details: Use golden set (1,200 prompts) + CI hook. Metrics: compile/lint pass, unit-test success, token-level perplexity delta, edit-distance to golden completions, hallucination score. Gates threshold config stored in Console per-route.
implementation_notes: They want model pinning exposed in SDK and IDE extension: explicit model_version param and fallback chain. Also request 'canary_percentage' API and webhook on gate failures. Interested in optimize suggestions for quantized variants when cost > threshold.
customer_quotes: If we can't reproduce a bug to the exact model state, it's worthless to engineers.
Need deterministic results for regression triage — not just 'close enough'.
procurement_notes: Procurement flagged EULA around model weights and redistribution. Expect SOW + security addendum. Target ARR band aligns with estimated range. Legal timeline ~3-4 weeks once final SOW provided.

final_comment: High intent, engineering-led buy. Key wins: clear reproducibility features + automated eval gates. Risk: legal & on-prem validation timeline. Close likely if Dedicated POC shows stable compile pass and deployment meets KMS/residency needs.
